storePath.label: Password store path
storePath.desc: Custom path to the password store (default: ~/.password-store)

clipTimeout.label: Clipboard timeout
clipTimeout.desc: Seconds before the clipboard is cleared (blank = use PASSWORD_STORE_CLIP_TIME)

typeDelay.label: Type delay
typeDelay.desc: Delay in milliseconds before typing starts (default: 500)

wtypeDelay.label: wtype keystroke delay
wtypeDelay.desc: Delay between keystrokes in milliseconds for wtype (default: 12)
